activities.title: Grounding
activities.goal: Notice real things around you at your own pace.
situation_fit: wants a brief sensory noticing guide
activities.summary: Take a moment to notice what is around you. Follow at your pace. Skip any prompt.
steps: Notice 3 things you can see.
Notice 2 things you can hear.
Notice one comfortable point of contact, such as your feet or the chair.
activities.completion_signal: User acknowledges or skips each sense, then chooses to finish.

activities.title: Paced Breathing
activities.goal: Follow a comfortable rhythm or breathe at your own pace.
activities.summary: Breathe gently without forcing it. Stop anytime if it feels uncomfortable.
steps: Follow a comfortable rhythm, or breathe at your own pace.
Breathe gently without forcing it.
Stop anytime if it feels uncomfortable.
activities.completion_signal: User finishes a guided round, chooses another, or stops.

activities.title: Brain Dump
activities.goal: Put thoughts somewhere temporary without needing to organize them.
activities.summary: Write what is on your mind. Sorting it is optional, and the draft is temporary.
steps: What keeps coming back to mind?
Write freely. You can leave it messy.
Choose one thing to talk about, or stop here.
activities.completion_signal: User finishes, selects a topic, or stops.

activities.title: Tiny Next Step / Task Reset
activities.goal: Choose one manageable next action from a crowded list.
activities.summary: Get tasks out of your head, sort if useful, and choose one small action.
steps: What is taking up space?
Sort or edit the list if useful.
Choose one small next action, or stop here.
activities.completion_signal: User chooses an action or stops.

activities.title: One Small Step
activities.goal: Turn a task into one clear first move.
situation_fit: knows a task but needs an easier start
activities.summary: Choose one task and make its first move easier to start.
steps: Choose a starting path.
Select one task.
Name one small first move.
activities.completion_signal: User creates a first-move card, optionally tries or keeps it, or leaves.

activities.title: Notice & Name
activities.goal: Describe what is happening in the user's own words.
situation_fit: wants to make sense of a recent event
wants to put an experience into words
activities.summary: What comes closest to this moment? Choose words, use your own, or leave it uncertain.
steps: Choose words that fit, if any.
Edit a phrase in your own words.
You can finish or check a thought.
activities.completion_signal: User selects, writes, reflects, skips, or stops.

activities.title: Write 100 Words to Them
activities.goal: Draft a short note about what the user wishes someone understood.
situation_fit: wants to write before deciding what to do
activities.summary: Write what you wish they understood. The 100-word target is optional; the note stays unsent.
steps: What do you wish they understood?
Write a few words or as much as you want.
Choose whether to save this letter privately.

activities.title: Reach Out
activities.goal: Consider contacting someone and prepare what to say.
situation_fit: wants support from someone they choose
wants to prepare what to say
activities.summary: Choose a starting point, edit a message, and decide whether to keep or copy it. Mira will not send it.
steps: Choose what you might want to ask for.
Edit the message in your own words.
Preview the exact text before you copy, keep, or return.
activities.completion_signal: User drafts, decides not to contact, or stops.

activities.title: Move / Change Your Scene
activities.goal: Choose a comfortable change of scene or movement.
situation_fit: wants an accessible brief change of scene
activities.summary: Choose a short walk, comfortable movement, a change of spot, or a no-movement break. Movement is optional.
steps: Choose an accessible break that feels comfortable, or skip.
Put your phone away and come back whenever you want.
Let Mira know what you chose.
activities.completion_signal: User returns, chooses another option, skips, or stops.

activities.title: One Song Break
activities.goal: Take a user-chosen listening break using their music app.
situation_fit: wants to take a short listening break
wants to use music they choose
wants a break without in-app playback
activities.summary: Choose music in your app or provide an allowlisted music link. Mira cannot tell whether it plays.
steps: Choose your music app or enter a music link.
Switch to your music app and listen for as long as you want.
Return and tell Mira what you chose.
activities.completion_signal: User returns and self-reports, skips, or stops.

activities.title: Unsent Message
activities.goal: Write freely to someone without deciding whether to send it.
situation_fit: has words they are not ready to say
activities.summary: Write freely. Nothing is sent, and saving the letter is your choice.
steps: Who or what is this message for? (Optional)
Write whatever you want to say.
Choose whether to save this letter privately.

activities.title: Unsent Letter
activities.goal: Write what you wish you could say, without deciding whether to send it.
situation_fit: has words they are not ready to say
wants to write at their own pace
wants to review a letter before closing it
activities.summary: Write what you wish you could say. You do not have to send it.
steps: Add a name if you want, then write at your own pace.
Read your letter or return to editing.
Choose whether to discard it or bring a selected part to Talk.
activities.completion_signal: User reviews, discards, transfers a selected excerpt, or stops.

activities.title: Perspective Shift
activities.goal: Consider possible interpretations without assuming another person's thoughts.
situation_fit: trying to make sense of someone's response
stuck on what another person meant
activities.summary: Explore a possible view from their side. These are guesses, not facts.
steps: What do you know for sure?
What are a few things they might have been thinking? These are only possibilities.
Does any possibility change what you want to do next?
activities.completion_signal: User considers, rejects, skips, or stops.
